title: Delivery intent hotfix: bare `báo` inside compound nouns (báo cáo/chỉ báo/quảng bá) must not authorize a send
description: Owner-approved minimal hotfix (BASE 95c7a71). CONFIRMED on the P15.10-D post-merge E2E stack: three real governed mission goals (Vietnamese, CEO-authored) died on FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING because DELIVERY_VERB_RE matched bare `báo` inside compound nouns `báo cáo` (report), `chỉ báo` (indicator), `quảng bá` (promotion), each within CLAUSE_SPAN of a Telegram mention, unnegated -> requested:true minted unauthorized send authority and the planner correctly emitted no delivery task. Fix in detectTelegramDeliveryIntent only, mirroring the existing `post` special-case: a bare `báo` match is skipped when the next word is `cáo` or the previous word is `chỉ`/`quảng` (Unicode-safe bounded context checks). Grammar unchanged otherwise; negation, clause span, artifact manifest and the pinned true-positive `báo kết quả qua telegram` -> requested:true all preserved. New suite pair-delivery-intent-compound.test.ts pins the 3 real E2E goals plus N1-N8 negatives and P1-P6 positives: prepatch 8 FAIL -> postpatch 17/17 PASS. Regressions: planner-dataflow-incident (incl. R3 intent contract), ops-telegram-delivery, output-delivery-contract, f4-delivery-provenance, p15-8e-telegram, p15-8-hotfix1, contract-simplify, prv2b-goal-coverage, pgrammar2 all green except ONE pre-existing baseline failure (f4-delivery-provenance R5.1-crash) which fails identically on unmodified BASE. tsc clean, build green. Known limitation documented for owner: a genuinely intended send phrased `báo cáo ...` is now skipped (fail-closed toward no-send; operators use gửi/đăng/đẩy). No merge, no deploy.
